drafts.title: Hope This Helps
drafts.pitch: The stop sequence is "Hope this helps," and Cursor can't finish an answer without almost saying it, until Tilde says it on the way out the door.
drafts.reason: Tilde walking out the stop door and saying the forbidden phrase is a good reversal, but the stop-sequence mechanic is more insider than a non-expert will get, and the strip never explains why the phrase is dangerous.

drafts.title: Six Ships
drafts.pitch: The Judge gives Cursor's joke a 6 no matter how much Cursor improves it, or ruins it.
drafts.reason: The repeated 6 is a decent rule of three, but the payoff "Six ships" is a non-sequitur that doesn't land, and the strip barely uses the room, the door or the rest of the cast.
